As I've spoken to different people about their covid summer...which has now stretchd into three covid years for many of us, I've come to realize that everybody in the world had completely different years, with the common threads being isolation and trauma, and not necessarily trauma directly related to the pandemic itself. It's all of the knock-on effects on relationships and social dynamics that aren't obviously related to covid-19 that make any discussion of these traumas into a sprawling conversation about life, the universe, and everything. 

My year was a bit more dramatic than most. And at first, it was a lot of fun. Until it wasn't. The following might be TMI... Who am i kidding, this is all FAR too much information. But honestly world, we've got to talk. Luckily, Columbus is a surprisingly open minded place to live. But, at a 45 minute drive, where we're going (Lancaster) is a world apart. 

It all started with me and my then 7-year girlfriend, Liz making a bunch of new friends in 2019, after moving back to Columbus from NYC. A tight-knit group of polyamorous burner types who called themselves the "Cuddlefish". It started off fine, and we'd had casual dates with some in the group and participated in the community, going to shows and parties—but it was all about to go to shit, resulting in me breaking up with Liz because I fell in love hard with another newcomer to the Cuddlefish (like magically; soul mate is a loaded word, but that kind of thing; i called Amanda my spirit animal). We’re all poly, but Covid hit right about then, and made everything more complicated, so long story short, moved into my own apt, moved again, this time to a small city 45 minutes out of town, with Amanda, her husband, and their three kids. Since we were isolating, we spent the summer making their house into a psychedelic funhouse/antiques museum, complete with lighting and fog machine. I took up half a dozen new hobbies, we started an online antiques shop, and an extremely fun, extremely stressful year, followed by a greulling two years of social revolution in microcosm, and legal battles that, despite my constant efforts to keep self-destructive loved ones from harming themselves and others, has cost me everything. 

That’s just the prologue. It gets more interesting but first, let's just talk about where we're headed.

As I write this today, I stand devestated by the Fairfield County Municipal and Civil Courts and their fact-proof radical mucking about in the lives of people that they are absolutely determined to learn nothing about, preferring innuendo and superstition to hard evidence has, in the span of two cases over as many years, quite literally 1) provided cover for a the kidnapping of a teenaged girl by her sociopathic child-abusing gandfather and his "bewitched" wife, in direct opposition to the findings of the specialists who have genuine wisdom in these matters, and who literally spent months in and out of the household conducting intensive and extremely stressful investigations, 2) destroyed the lives of three formerly vibrant and successful adults who provided a loving home for three children at just the time in their lives when such disruption can cause the deepest scars, 3) destroyed the relationships between the children, as well as the relationships between the children and their parents and adopted adults, and 4) has perverted the purposes of a well-intended victims' rights law to it into a tool that treats a rapistas the victim of the person she raped for the crime of speaking up, a victim who, had the Court not stepped in and turned them all against each other, would have forgiven her and worked tirelessly to heal the scars of everyone in the household, but through this awful Court's pompous recklessness, denying the victim due process and forcing him into hopeless unemployment and mental anguish. The Fairfield County Prosecutor's office, and the Legal Offices of Conrad & Wood, along with the Lancaster Police Department have actively assisted in these horrendous crimes committed by the Courts against one household of innocent Lancaster citizens, pitting against each other the victims who were once able to sort out their own problems in a thoughtful and forgiving way, forcing the very people already traumatized by these so-called legal officials' callus disregard for human well being into fighting amongst themselves in both legal and illegal ways just to distract this vicious Court's attention away from themselves in hopes of escaping whatever other cruelties the Court has threatened to inflict. Whether this is a result of sheer blind arrogance and cynical contempt for jurisprudence, morality, and ethics or deliberate and conscious modern-day equivalent of burning at the stake, the result is the same. The craven bullying and flippant exercises of extralegal power engaged in by Judge Landerfeld, Mr. Conrad, Asst. Prossecutor Sabo, Lt. Luikhart, and others has turned one of the most beautifully vibrant groups of human beings I have ever known into a years-long nightmare where the victims of this Court have been driven by fear and intimidation to turn around and abuse their fellow victims, or to turn to self-abuse in a desperate luge to escape. This Court's indelicate hammer of accusation has turned kind and intelligent, productive men and women into unemployable chronically self-loathing wrecks on the verge of suicide. This might sound hyperbolic to officials who glibly view human beings, their lives and their families as theirs to toss around as they see fit. But I assure you, whoever ends up reading this (with mercy, directly into the faces of these officers of the Court) ...this pitched paragraph is the essence of understatement. 

Back to the Cuddlefish (the burners I mentioned) basically tore themselves apart simultaneously, but we kept a couple close contacts as friends, and when the kids were away on the weekends, the four or five of us did a lot of drugs and had a lot of interesting sexual experiences. But her parents are abusive monsters who have always tried to control her, and enlisted the entire extended family to make life as difficult for us as possible. Those stresses, along with everything around Covid exacerbated some existing rifts and put us all on edge, so new and old traumas, isolation and the changing dynamics of the house led to Amanda and I breaking up, getting back together, and breaking up again. And now, I’m back in my own place, rebuilding a friend network since my whole social circle fell apart, transforming my apartment and yard into a mystical fairy garden/sex dungeon/photo studio/darkroom/workspace for restoring and modifying antique cameras, and my other art and hobbies. 🤷🏽‍♂️

My goal in putting this all together is to understand the factors that contributed to my accuser's successful manipulations, and to speak out for the purpose of educating others who may find themselves wrongly accused, and to prepare for the unlikely event that turns out to be necessary to seek future legal or administrative corrective measures.
